correctness.rationale: Every complete terminal word has a unique S/D decomposition; the length count satisfies the Fibonacci recurrence. A complete integer Eratosthenes sieve enumerates every prime through 1803947 and the checker greedily constructs the canonical Zeckendorf digits, parses the entire semi-proper block sequence, records first primes for every completed prefix length 1..20 and verifies all expected class counts, maxima, and last witnesses. The exact code was executed from the public package with VERIFY_OK, with 135340 primes enumerated. No conjectural infinite extrapolation is used.
